title: the artifact hooks install LF on every box
intention: Every hook cairn artifact installs reaches .git/hooks as LF bytes, whatever line endings the box's checkout gave its source.
why: akiendell_cc_0 measured 2026-11-16 (read-only): cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/pre-commit is CRLF in akiendell's working tree (git ls-files --eol: i/lf w/crlf attr/; core.autocrlf=true in cairn), with no .gitattributes rule (check-attr eol: unspecified); and neither cairn nor CairnCommons there has any hook installed (.git/hooks holds only samples, core.hooksPath unset), so the artifact door runs nowhere on that box today, and install-hook's shutil.copyfile would lay a CRLF hook that bash refuses on $'\r'. On Linux the same hooks carry no eol attribute either; only cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit has one (ticket daaf7ac3e4ec).
traces_to: Law 4: the artifact door is physics only where its hook runs, and a CRLF hook on a Windows box does not run.
how: Two halves, because an attribute alone does not rewrite a working copy already checked out CRLF. (a) .gitattributes gains 'cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/* text eol=lf', beside the tester's line. (b) In cairn/tools/artifact/__main__.py, every hook install (pre-commit, pre-merge-commit, commit-msg) writes the source's bytes with CRLF folded to LF, through one helper, instead of shutil.copyfile. The proof cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_the_artifact_hooks_install_lf_on_every_box.py reads the attribute for every file under cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/, checks out this tree's hooks and .gitattributes in a scratch repo cloned with core.autocrlf=true, and calls the installer in-process over a CRLF copy of each source.

clauses.claim: git check-attr reports eol: lf for every file under cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/; red on the base, where it is unspecified
a scratch clone with core.autocrlf=true of a repo holding this .gitattributes and the artifact hooks checks out every hook with no CR byte; red on the base

install-hook and install-title-hook, handed CRLF sources, install pre-commit, pre-merge-commit and commit-msg with no CR byte, each equal to its source with CRLF folded to LF, and executable; red on the base, which copies the CR through

decisions.text: D2: every hook install writes the source bytes with CRLF folded to LF, through one helper.
D3: one proof, one tooth per clause.

out: cairn/devices/tester (its hooks and their eol line are the tester's)
